decisions.reason: As a low-cost charting add-on tightly tied to our established web-mapping stack, we would keep it unless accumulated demand has clearly fallen below aspiration despite its weaker recent visibility.
After several years without renewed visibility, this narrow mobile control component is likely to have fallen below aspiration or been technologically superseded, so we would redeploy the resources.
Because this platform is a flagship line central to our direction and reusable across many customer projects, we would retain it even if short-run standalone signals are mixed.

Mobile field data capture still fits our enterprise and public-sector GIS business, so with some organizational slack we would keep it, though the lack of later prominence raises the risk if results stayed under aspiration.
Given the earlier withdrawal of the related search product and no later sign of strong traction, this search extension is more likely below aspiration than worth continued separate support.
